description: Builds UNSIGNED transactions to cancel one of your resting orders via Account.cancelOrder on your own SMX Account. Any unclaimed fills on that order get claim transactions first (cancelling with an unclaimed fill forfeits it on v1 contracts). Never signs.

wallet.description: Your own wallet address (EOA that owns the SMX Account). Never a private key.

name: smx_build_cancel
title: SMX: build an unsigned cancel
